Thanks for the time today, Samir - good conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we all have the same plan.

High-level notes:
- Primary use case: customer support auto-summary + suggested reply composer for Tier 1 agents (English, en-US).
- Volume estimate: ~450k messages/month, 75k unique conversations for initial rollout.
- Latency SLO: 95th < 300ms for short responses (<= 256 tokens); some batched offline scoring for reranking.
- Quality bar: prefer fewer hallucinations on knowledge pulls; acceptable latency tradeoff for 1-2 token longer responses if factuality improves.
- Data: live customer transcripts - need guidance on PII handling/redaction before sending prompts to any eval environment.

Model fit / evaluation ask:
1) We need a representative prompt set (examples + edge cases) to run our model-fit evals and surface where models regress. Attached is a small prompt_collection_template.csv - please fill with 30-50 real examples covering high-frequency and edge-case threads (refunds, escalations, long conversational context, HTML / signatures).
2) Please flag any prompts that contain PII or regulated data. If you prefer, you can return a redacted CSV and include an indicator column for redaction type. See attached redaction_guidance.pdf for examples.
3) We'll run a benchmark against our standard model suite and share the result dashboard + a short write-up of recommended model(s) and quantization profiles for cost/latency tradeoffs.

Recommended next steps (timeline):
- You: return prompt_collection_template.csv + any redaction notes by EOD Fri (8/20).
- Us: Mateo will schedule a quick bench run and share initial results within 3 business days after we receive the prompts.
- Follow-up: 30-minute sync to review model fit results and proposed rollout plan.

Attachments: prompt_collection_template.csv, redaction_guidance.pdf

Thanks - I’ll loop in Mateo to arrange the bench slot.

Best,
Marissa Cole
